methodologyNotes: Covers standalone electric pet drinking fountains for cats and small-to-medium dogs sold at a published US price. Excludes non-powered gravity waterers, faucet-attached dispensers, and outdoor livestock troughs. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. capacityLiters is usable reservoir volume in liters. material is the primary water-contact construction as an enum (plastic, stainless-steel, ceramic). pumpPowerWatts is the rated pump power in watts; null if not disclosed. noiseLevelDb is the manufacturer-rated operating noise in dB(A); null if not disclosed. filterStages is the number of filtration stages as an integer count. filterLifeDays is the manufacturer-recommended filter replacement interval in days. powerSource is an enum (usb-corded, ac-adapter, wireless-battery). waterLevelWindow is a boolean for a visible external water-level indicator or window. lowWaterAlert is a boolean for a low-water LED/app alert or automatic pump shut-off. appConnectivity is a boolean for WiFi or Bluetooth app monitoring. flowModes is the number of selectable flow/stream modes as an integer count. weightGrams is the empty product weight in grams.

products.name: PETLIBRO Dockstream Cordless Water Fountain
products.priceNote: US price from the Walmart listing sold by PETLIBRO's official store: "Current price is USD $69.99" for "PETLIBRO Dockstream Automatic Cat Water Fountain, 2.5L Cordless Water Dispenser, Quiet Pump, Stainless Steel" (model PLWF115). PETLIBRO.com no longer sells this original cordless model standalone (its Fountains catalog now lists only the successor Dockstream 2 at $79.99-$89.99), so the manufacturer store does not currently publish a price for PLWF115; the Walmart figure is the current US retail price for this exact model.
products.provenance: The official PETLIBRO comparison page (petlibro.com) pins the model identity: "Dockstream Cordless Water Fountain" = model PLWF115 — the battery-operated/cordless 2.5L (84oz) variant with a low water level indicator, no APP support, no visible water tank, and a 990g net weight — distinguishing it from the plug-in Dockstream (PLWF005/PLWF105) and the newer 3L Dockstream 2 (PLWF106/PLWF116). The Walmart listing sold by PETLIBRO's official store confirms the US price ("Current price is USD $69.99"), the "barely audible 23dB" noise rating, the 4-stage vertical filtration (1. ion-exchange resin, 2. activated carbon, 3. non-woven fabric, 4. high-density sponge), stainless-steel-tray-plus-ABS construction, and the two "Dual Water Modes" (motion-sensor induction + continuous). Amazon independently corroborates "Item model number: PLWF115," 2.5L capacity, and material "Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS), Stainless Steel" for the same cordless fountain; pump power watts and filter life days are left blank because no fetched page disclosed a rated pump wattage (only a 5V/1A charging-adapter output) or a filter-replacement interval in days.
